rules: Strong evidence (ships as a new version): >= 10 closed trades in the bucket, average R beyond +/-0.25R, bootstrap P >= 0.9.
Weak signal (becomes a challenger, tested only on NEW trades): >= 5 closed trades, P >= 0.75.
Gate challengers: promote when >= 10 closed shadow trades with that tag beat Main by >= 0.25R at P >= 0.9 and are profitable; drop when P(beat Main) <= 0.50.
Calibration (setup score and RS rating vs R) is judged only after 15 closed scored trades.
Swing metrics tracked per bucket: win rate, average and median R, T1 and T2 hit rates, average days held, average MFE and MAE.
Rollback: a version with >= 10 closed Main trades whose average R trails its parent at P >= 0.8.

DEFENSIVE risk mode (automatic): Main book 5% below peak or 3 losing Main closes in a row. Risk per trade x0.5, max 3 concurrent Main positions, High-confidence setups only. Back to NORMAL when drawdown < 2.5%, the streak is broken and 5 business days have passed.

glossary.Swing trade: A long position in shares held for roughly 2 weeks to 3 months, aiming for +10% to +25% with a stop 5-9% below the entry.
glossary.Main account: The trades the method actually makes, with every rule applied. $100,000 paper account.
glossary.Shadow account: The next-best setups that one rule kept out of Main (rank, sector cap, earnings too close, stop too wide, reward:risk too low...). Tracked the same way so we learn whether each rule helps.
glossary.Breakout: The stock built a sideways base near its highs and tightened. We buy only if it trades above the top of the base (the pivot) with a buy-stop order.
glossary.Pullback: A stock in an uptrend dipped back to its rising 20-day or 50-day average. We buy in a limit zone around that average.
glossary.Post-catalyst drift: After a big gap up on news (earnings, guidance), strong stocks often keep drifting higher. We buy above the post-gap high.
glossary.Oversold reversal: A stock in a long-term uptrend sold off hard to support, then printed a reversal bar. We buy above that bar.
glossary.Buy-stop: An order that only buys if the price rises to the trigger. If the stock opens above it, the fill is at the (worse) open.
glossary.Limit zone: A resting buy limit: fills only at or below the top of the zone, at the better of the limit and the bar open.
glossary.Order validity: Entry orders rest for 5 trading days. If they do not fill by then they are cancelled, and a stop trade before the trigger cancels them early.
glossary.Stop: The technical level where the setup is wrong. Checked on every 5-minute bar; it always goes first.
glossary.T1 / T2: T1 is +10%: sell half and move the stop on the rest to breakeven. T2 is +20% (+25% at new highs or after deep bases): sell the rest.
glossary.Time stop: If the trade has not worked within 8-10 weeks of the fill, it is closed at the market.
glossary.Earnings rule: No new entry within 10 trading days of a report. At the close before the report: hold the rest if T1 is banked, sell half if up 5% or more, otherwise exit.
glossary.Relative strength (RS): 3 to 12 month performance ranked 1-99 against the ~900 liquid US stocks scanned (weighted toward the last 3 months), plus 3-month return versus SPY and the sector fund.
glossary.Setup score: 0-100: relative strength (30), trend (20), setup quality (25), reward:risk (10), distance to entry (10), sector (5), catalyst (3), earnings timing (+/-3).
glossary.ATR: Average true range: the stock's typical daily move. A stop closer than about 1.5 ATR tends to get hit by noise.
glossary.R / R-multiple: Profit or loss divided by the amount risked. +1R means we made what we risked; -1R means a full stop-out.
glossary.R:R: Reward-to-risk to T2: (T2 minus entry) divided by (entry minus stop). The minimum is 2.5.
glossary.Position sizing: Risk 2% (High confidence) or 1.5% (Medium) of the account at the stop, capped at 25% of the account per position and by the cash on hand. Max 5 positions.
glossary.MFE / MAE: Maximum favourable / adverse excursion: the best and worst the trade got while open. Used in post-mortems.
glossary.Challenger: A rule we test in the Shadow account against the current rule (the champion). Promoted only on strong evidence.
glossary.Paper trade: A simulated trade at real market prices. No money is used.

fill_policy: Entry orders rest 5 trading days. Buy-stops fill at max(trigger, bar open) + 0.2%; limit zones at min(limit, bar open). Exits on 5-minute bars: stop first, T1 sells half and moves the stop to breakeven, T2 sells the rest, time stop at 15:50 ET. Gaps through a level fill at the worse open. Nothing fills or closes on a stale quote.
